title: Eureka Blueberries
summary: Mountain Blue's own page for the Eureka brand, claiming jumbo size, exceptional sweetness and a crisp, juicy texture, and describing Eureka both as a cultivar and as a family of related varieties.
why_it_matters: This page is the origin of the Eureka naming ambiguity: the same word is used for a single patented cultivar and for an umbrella brand covering several distinct cultivars. Any dataset that merges the two will misattribute trait, volume and pricing data.

reading.rationale: Essential for understanding the Eureka naming structure before any Eureka data is interpreted.

testing.rationale: The sweetness and texture claims are testable.

commercial_position.rationale: Brand architecture shapes how the genetics are sold, not how they perform.
